name: Interdisciplinary Common Cold Evaluation Rubric
description: Common cold evaluation rubric for all disciplines in interdisciplinary projects

criteria.name: Interdisciplinary Synthesis & Integration
criteria.description: Cross-discipline coherence, shared architecture, and integration rigor
criteria.learningOutcome: PLO-03: Synthesize interdisciplinary system components into cohesive solution
criteria.evidenceGuidance: Review system architecture diagrams, cross-discipline API contracts, and integration test coverage

levels.label: Chưa đạt (Unsatisfactory)
levels.descriptor: No discernible cross-discipline integration; components operate as disconnected silos

levels.label: Đạt yêu cầu (Developing)
levels.descriptor: Basic interface definitions exist but lack cohesive interdisciplinary workflow

levels.label: Tốt (Proficient)
levels.descriptor: Solid end-to-end integration across all disciplines with verified data flows

levels.label: Xuất sắc (Exemplary)
levels.descriptor: Seamless integration, comprehensive contracts, resilient error handling across domains
